svg.aria-label: Containers versus virtual machines: VMs each run a full guest kernel on a hypervisor; containers are ordinary processes sharing the host kernel, isolated by namespaces (what they can see) and limited by cgroups (how much CPU and memory they can use).
svg.title: Containers versus virtual machines: VMs each run a full guest kernel on a hypervisor; containers are ordinary processes sharing the host kernel, isolated by namespaces (what they can see) and limited by cgroups (how much CPU and memory they can use).
svg.text: namespaces: own view of PIDs, network, files
